subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `memory status` treat persisted `vectorDims` as a prior-success vector-store readiness signal while keeping `--deep` as the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: This is a small bug fix, but it deliberately changes the meaning of plain CLI and JSON status from current-process probe state to persisted index readiness when vector metadata exists.

options.title: Accept metadata-backed fast status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should summarize the previously indexed vector store and reserve live sqlite-vec loadability for `--deep`.

options.title: Require live-probe wording or shape
options.body: Revise the output or JSON field so metadata-backed readiness is distinguishable from a current-process vector-store probe before merge.

options.title: Pause for a different status contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect this branch if maintainers want another canonical fix path.

recommendation.title: Accept metadata-backed fast status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should summarize the previously indexed vector store and reserve live sqlite-vec loadability for `--deep`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the live assignee on this PR, so he is the best available owner for the merge-risk decision even though memory-core feature history also points to steipete.
